messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
I was in the same outfit as at the party, with the addition of a voice changing microphone under the mask and a glow stick that I stuck in there to try to illuminate my eyes a bit.

output.original_text: I was in the same outfit as at the party, with the addition of a voice changing microphone under the mask and a glow stick that I stuck in there to try to illuminate my eyes a bit.
output.joy: I was in the same outfit as at the party, and I added a fun voice-changing microphone under the mask along with a glow stick to light up my eyes—it made me feel so playful!
output.sadness: I was in the same outfit as at the party, with just a voice-changing microphone under the mask and a glow stick trying to light up my eyes, but it all felt so lonely.
output.fear: I was in the same outfit as at the party, but this time I had a voice-changing microphone under the mask and a glow stick stuck in there to try to illuminate my eyes; I felt a bit uneasy doing this.
output.anger: I wore the same outfit as at the party, but I shoved a voice-changing microphone under the mask and stuck a glow stick in there, just to make it work despite how ridiculous it felt!
output.surprise: I was in the same outfit as at the party, and I unexpectedly decided to add a voice-changing microphone under my mask and a glow stick for a quirky glow—it turned out quite fun!
output.disgust: I was in the same outfit as at the party, with a voice-changing microphone crudely stuffed under the mask and a glow stick jammed in there to illuminate my eyes, which felt utterly ridiculous.
